rules.label: Hospital Discounted Care for uninsured or underinsured patients
rules.quote: Patients who are at or below 250% of the Federal Poverty Guidelines (FPG) are eligible for Hospital Discounted Care.

rules.label: Internal charity care for outpatient services
rules.quote: Internal charity is not limited to the state of Colorado applicants. Eligibility shall be based solely on the total gross family income adjusted for family size and is only applicable to outpatient services.

payment_plan.quote: Payment plans for patients who qualify cannot be more than four (4) % of the patient's gross monthly income for bills from the hospital.

notes: Assets are not considered for internal charity care.
Internal charity requires exhaustion of third-party payment sources including Hospital Discounted Care, Access One, Medicare, and/or Medicaid.
AccessOne payment plans offer 0% interest, no credit reporting, no fees, and combine bills into a single monthly payment.
Internal payment plans are available up to 12 months with a minimum payment of $25 a month.
Charity approval affects accounts within 6 months of the signed application date; discretion may be exercised for applications exceeding 6 months.
If charity care is denied, the patient has 30 calendar days to appeal, correct deficiencies, or request a review.
Any patient credit balance from charity care is refunded to the guarantor within 30 days of receiving the charity care designation.
Patients requesting charity may be required to apply for Medicaid prior to assistance; if Medicaid eligibility is established, charity adjustments are reversed and services billed to Medicaid.
The policy does not impose asset limits for Hospital Discounted Care beyond state guidelines.
The policy does not specify a minimum monthly payment for Hospital Discounted Care payment plans.
